units.source_text: 大概一周后，这位画家拜访了他。

en.t: About a week later, this painter came to visit him.

units.source_text: 在他的一生中是件很特别的事情。

en.t: It was a very special event in his life.

units.source_text: 他发现了画家身上从未被人发现的那一面。

en.t: He discovered a side of the painter that no one had ever discovered before.

units.source_text: 而且，还发现了画家本人也尚未了解的画家的灵魂。

en.t: Moreover, he also discovered the painter's soul, which even the painter himself had not yet understood.
